_readme: Copied to config.json on the first start (config.json is yours and is not in git). See docs/CONFIG.md.

network._note: Phone / other devices. OFF by default. To use it: enabled=true, addresses = this PC's IP on your home network (192.168.x.x) or Tailscale (100.x.x.x). Other devices need the key in data/key.txt.

engine._note: Used by START.bat / start.sh to launch llama-server. backend: vulkan (AMD/Intel/NVIDIA), cuda (NVIDIA), cpu, or metal on macOS (automatic).

local._note: Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint works (llama-server, KoboldCPP, LM Studio, Ollama's /v1...).

kobold._note: Optional fallback: KoboldCPP on its default port, used only if 'local' is off.

order._note: For each job, the engines to try in order: the first one running is used.
